ops.title: Scaffold/bootstrap wave review verdict — 13 fixes applied + verified
ops.body:
Two independent codex (gpt-5.6-sol xhigh) reviews of the pack scaffold + marketplace self-bootstrap wave (commits 1aea4c64, 84dbfacd, 4fa3e5d2) produced 22 findings (heavy overlap). Fable adjudication accepted 13, applied in commit `e17adb5e` ("fix(packs): harden scaffold merge-engine + bootstrap worker per review", +341/-58 across bootstrap.py, contract.py, scaffold.py + tests).

**Accepted & fixed:** non-list `dependencies` refused (was spread into char-deps); captain-hook dep identified by name not marketplace (a foreign `{name:other, marketplace:captain-hook}` was being renamed); non-list allowlist refused (was silently coerced+overwritten → data loss); malformed hooks.json shapes refused instead of AttributeError; existing/skip-marked `guard.py` never clobbered by the starter; compound commands like `capt-hook run Stop && /audit` refused instead of stripped (dropped the foreign tail); bootstrap worker launches `python -I -m captain_hook` (cwd/PYTHONPATH can't shadow); `run_bootstrap` uses absolute `shutil.which("claude")`; upward manifest search bounded at pack root (was rewriting an ancestor plugin's `.claude-plugin/`); `hooks="../x"` starter-write escape refused; plus LOW: empty-group preservation, miss-path spawn-race lock, marker-parse tolerance.

**Rejected (by-design / out-of-threat-model):** log-file symlink/FIFO hardening (owner-only state dir); consent/hidden-command reachability (auto-bootstrap is the approved design; the "attach writes nothing to stdout" doc line is corrected in Phase C docs, not code); `{"captain-hook": null}` treated as registered (correct — key presence = CC registered it); symlinked-manifest preservation (rare corner, follow-up).

**Verification (fable, post-fix):** 112 pack-surface tests pass; live reproductions of the four highest-value fixes (compound-command refusal, foreign-dep preservation, non-list-deps refusal, child-doesn't-touch-parent) all confirmed; `-I` and absolute-claude grep-confirmed. Full suite = 3359 passed / 10 failed, where all 10 are a concurrent session's staged-but-uncommitted `test_rewrite_command_occurrences.py` (zero references to wave files) — not this wave.
